messages:
Maria G.: FYI – planning a dry-run during the 02:00 UTC change window tonight. We'll do a staggered pin: runtime v3.12 -> v3.13 on dedicated pools, then router flag FQ-22, then console canary. API bump is config-only (minor). Need signoffs on rollout order and rollback criteria.
Jon P.: Thanks — can you list exact pin steps? I want to confirm the console migration won't trigger schema shims.
Maria G.: Sure. High-level:
- 02:00: pin runtime on one shard (canary) -> smoke tests
- 02:15: flip router flag FQ-22 for 5% traffic to canary
- 02:30: pin console but keep read-only on canary
- 02:45: bump API config (no schema change)
- 03:00: evaluate metrics, expand if green
Kevin L.: Lgtm. Add a KV cache eviction watch after runtime pin — earlier runs showed a small surge in evictions.
Sophie R.: I'll own console canary. Can we add an automatic rollback trigger on console errors >= 2% 5m? Also capture any JS console errors in Sentry.
Maria G.: Agreed on rollback triggers. Proposed rollback rules: any latency p95 degradation > 200ms for more than 5m OR error rate > 2% -> immediate router traffic rollback to previous variant + unpin console. If runtime causes KV surge > 10% we'd rollback runtime pin and quarantine that shard.
deploy-bot: deploybot scheduled dry-run: runtime:v3.13 -> starting canary on shard runtime-us-east-3 at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z. See /deploy logs: https://deploy.internal/reports/1767432100
Jon P.: Quick question: what about model-serving kernels? runtime v3.13 selects new kernel that may be incompatible with some quantized variants. We should pin a compatible fallback model in the routing policy before traffic shift.
Kevin L.: Good catch. I'll prepare a routing fallback: if kernel mismatch detected then route to runtime-v3.12-compat variant. That should be automatic in 5xx responses.
Sophie R.: Console note: upgrade requires a small schema migration for feature flags — it's backward compatible but I'll keep read-only until 02:30 as planned.
oncall-sre: Monitoring hooks added: p95 latency, total error rate, KV eviction rate, and router 5xx spikes. Pager policy: SEV2 if traffic >1% users affected with p95>500ms.
Maria G.: Thanks everyone. Last ask — update release notes (short) and post a one-line banner in #general before we start. I'll post final checklist at 01:30 UTC.
Jon P.: I'll be online for the run. Ping me if router rollback happens.
Kevin L.: I'll watch KV eviction and model kernel logs.
Sophie R.: Console canary ready. Will capture Sentry and augment the runbook.
Maria G.: Cool — final checklist posted. Starting the dry-run unless someone objects.
Jon P.: :thumbsup:
Kevin L.: :thumbsup:
Sophie R.: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: dry-run started 2026-03-21T02:00:05Z — runtime canary on runtime-us-east-3. Logs at https://deploy.internal/logs/1767432100
oncall-sre: Observability note: 02:06 UTC p95 spiked to +120ms but within threshold. No errors.
Maria G.: Holding at 5% traffic. Proceed to console read-only pin at 02:30 if no regressions.
Sophie R.: Pin complete at 02:32, read-only enforced. Sentry captured 3 minor JS warnings, not blocking.
Kevin L.: KV eviction ticked up 3%, under threshold. kernel-fallback not triggered.
Jon P.: Router flag expanded to 20% at 02:45 per plan. No 5xx observed.
Maria G.: Looks green. We'll keep monitoring and tear down canary by 04:00 unless we decide to promote.
oncall-sre: Closing note — no rollbacks triggered. Will archive runbook notes to /runbooks/dryruns/1767432100.
Maria G.: Thanks all. I'll draft release note and assign follow-ups: Kevin (kv tuning), Sophie (console warnings), Jon (kernel compatibility checklist).
